items.name: Principal Hanya
items.tactic: Weak ONLY to Fire; nulls Water & Electric. Spam Fire Fusion Spells and answer "No, he made it." afterward.

items.name: Leader (Optional)
items.tactic: WARNING: Fighting him instead of choosing "Wait and see what happens" permanently locks out Eikichi's Prime Persona!

items.name: Council President
items.tactic: Weak to Fire, Earth, Ranged & Thrown; drains Water & Ice.

items.name: Prince Taurus
items.tactic: NO elemental weaknesses (repels Earth, nulls Ranged/Dark/Mind). Use non-Earth Fusion Spells + Media healing.

items.name: Ixquic & Belphegor
items.tactic: Ixquic weak to Sword & Light (nulls Ranged/Strike/Thrown/Havoc/Dark/Mind). Belphegor has NO weaknesses and resists Physical.

items.name: King Leo
items.tactic: Weak to Water & Ice; drains Fire and repels Nuclear.

items.name: [spoiler]Shadow Maya[/spoiler]
items.tactic: No weaknesses (resists Elements/Almighty 2/4, nulls Dark/Mind). Party starts at ~half HP, but fight is straightforward.

items.name: Longinus 13, 12, 11
items.tactic: 13 weak Fire, 12 weak Earth, 11 weak Water; all resist Physical (1/4). Checkpoints before Caracol.

items.name: Longinus 10, 9, 8 / [spoiler]Lady Scorpio & Shadow Yukino[/spoiler]
items.tactic: If Yukino stayed: Longinus 10/9/8 (Wind/Earth/Fire). If Yukino left: Lady Scorpio (Wind) & Shadow Yukino (Ice).

items.name: Joker & [spoiler]Angel Joker[/spoiler]
items.tactic: Joker has no weakness (repels Light/Dark). Angel Joker is weak to Dark (2x) and nulls Light/Nerve/Mind. Spam Fusion Spells + buffs.

items.name: Longinus 7, 6, 5
items.tactic: 7 weak Earth, 6 weak Wind, 5 weak Water; all resist Physical (1/4). Reward: Wind Crystal Skull.

items.name: [spoiler]Shadow Eikichi / Shadow Ginko / Shadow Tatsuya[/spoiler]
items.tactic: All three are weak to Light (2x). Equip each character's Ultimate Persona (Hades/Venus/Apollo) before fighting their Shadow.

items.name: Longinus 4, 3, 2, 1
items.tactic: "Definitely": L4–2 weak Water/Wind/Fire (4,000 HP), L1 none (5,000 HP). "Not so sure": L4–2 weak Ice/Elec/Nuc (5,000 HP), L1 6,000 HP.

items.name: Metal Daddy
items.tactic: No weaknesses; nulls Light/Dark/Nerve/Mind. Watch for Pressure Point (instant Strike kill) & buff defense.

items.name: Metal Mama
items.tactic: Jun absent. Repels ALL Magic & Almighty — use Physical/Melee attacks only.

items.name: 5x Bolontiku
items.tactic: Type 2 (Maya) repels ALL Magic & Almighty (weak only to Physical). Types 1/3/4/5 weak to Water+Ice / Wind / Fire / Earth.

items.name: [spoiler]Fuhrer[/spoiler]
items.tactic: No weaknesses; watch for Holy Grail (1–3 turn invincibility) & Holy Lance (Persona seal). Auto full heal afterward.

items.name: [spoiler]Great Father[/spoiler] (Final)
items.tactic: Head (Lv. 65, 13,308 HP) & 4 parts (Lv. 63, 5,000 HP each). Use AoE Fusion Spells on parts, then single-target Head; bring SP recovery.

items.name: Angel / Persephone / Kushiel
items.tactic: Optional PSP Climax Theater scenario bosses.
